changes.detail: Moved the existing photo-inferred <=21.5 m peak to the north-west roof/eaves corner and tapered the profile along the two adjacent edges to 17.6 m. The registered 2023 orthophoto XY, 0.18 m shell thickness, duplicate cleanup, soffit finish, low entrance deck, and dark notch remain. Height/warp are inferred, not measured.

Expanded the existing candidate long-wing glazing from z=15.15–18.85 m down to z=12.35–18.85 m, added repeated vertical mullions and one additional transom. Dimensions and stationing are photo-based interpretation only.

Added one modular combined mesh with 86 horizontal fins: 48 over 16 curved curtainwall bays at three existing transom levels, plus 38 along the expanded upper glazing at two levels. Kawneer documents Versoleil sunshade/outrigger system context; exact locations/depths/cadence are estimates.

limitations: The eaves trace does not verify the structural wall footprint or courtyard edges.
No measured facade schedule or dimensioned wall elevation was found; glazing and fin stationing/depths are qualitative estimates.
The 21.5 m peak/roof warp remains inferred; the 21.6 m LiDAR value is only a coarse ceiling.
Geotagged photographs lack heading/roll calibration and do not support exact facade registration.
